_why: Ratchet floors. A gate whose check count can fall silently cannot detect a deleted requirement: stripping four required headings from one pack made validate.py drop 1270->1269 and sloplint.py 224->223, both still green. Each number is the count measured on the commit named below. Raise freely; lowering one needs a reason in the same commit.
_raised: validate.py 1920 -> 1938: two new checks. validate_pack_container_answer() asks each of the ten widened packs which components size against their container -- a bullet the skeleton has carried since 1.5.0 and which seven packs left blank, so the contract asked and nothing checked. validate_kit_breakpoints() reads every width media query in the sixteen kits and requires either a :root-only block or a declared PAGE / SELF / TODO-CONTAINER reason; it found seven, and the first version of its own marker search looked back a fixed 400 characters and missed a five-line reason whose marker sat at 425 -- a check that fails on a longer explanation teaches shorter ones. validate_palette.py and sloplint.py are unchanged at 906 and 436.
